Rory (People Ops): Quick heads-up: all-hands tomorrow 9:30am PT. Please drop 1-2 line agenda bullets or questions by tonight. We'll record and post slides.

June (CEO): I'll open with a short company update and two north-star metrics.

Evan (Product): Demo of the Dedicated autopilot (8m) + canary timeline. tagging @Priya for infra notes.

Priya (Eng): I'll cover two engineering callouts: new batching defaults and the debug-log retention policy change for Dedicated customers.

Kai (Platform): I'll share p95 improvements from KV cache and a note on early quantization experiments.

Rory (People Ops): Draft agenda: 9:30 intro (June), 9:36 Product demo (Evan), 9:44 Eng callouts (Priya), 9:52 Platform metrics (Kai), 9:58 Q&A, 10:15 Close + TL;DR. Keep bullets short.

Evan (Product): please surface any rollout blockers here so we can triage ahead of the meeting.

Priya (Eng): CLI snippet to paste if asked about batching:
```
redwoodctl config set batching.max_batch 56
redwoodctl deploy inference --env=prod
```

notice-bot: Calendar invite posted -> https://calendar.example.com/event/4001230000 (Zoom link in invite). Reminder scheduled.

(After meeting) notice-bot: Recording + slides -> https://videos.example.com/recordings/4001230000 and https://drive.example.com/4001230000-slides.pdf

Rory (People Ops): Post-meeting TL;DR: Autopilot canary next week (owners assigned), debug-log retention default = 30 days (Dedicated can request extensions via support), dark-mode opt-in live, p95 down ~16% after KV cache. Follow-ups in the shared doc.

June (CEO): Thanks team  great demos and clear customer wins.
